warnings.message: This paid managed tier is a planning proposal, not validated capacity or an availability SLA. Validate pool limits, concurrent clients, CPU/memory, backup restore and the requested p95/availability before deployment; no automatic HA replicas are assumed.
99.99% is a target, not a product guarantee. The cost model provisions redundancy assumptions; service terms, failover and workload behavior still require verification.
Infrastructure estimate USD 1628.64–4067.03/month exceeds the USD 0 budget at the lower bound; this is an explicitly over-budget plan, with no requirement silently relaxed.

Planning bands combine published reference rates and explicitly authored allowances; they are not regional provider quotes or measured workload capacity. Validate sizing, merchant/SMS eligibility, storage, requests and current tariffs before purchase.
